Thanks Emma — answers inline below (and I’ve asked Dev to add technical detail):

> 1) Can you confirm the regions where customer data is stored (primary and backups)?
- Primary inference and customer data are hosted in customer-region clusters. For our hosted service we currently run clusters in us-east-1 (primary for North America) and europe-west1 (for EU customers when requested). Backups are encrypted at rest and retained per customer DPA settings; default backups are stored in the same region unless customer specifically requests cross-region replication.

> 2) Which cloud providers do you use for production inference vs. analytics/telemetry?
- Production inference: AWS (EC2/GPU) is primary; we also have validated GCP zones for specific customers and Dedicated deployments.
- Analytics/telemetry: we use a managed logging/metrics vendor and an analytics warehouse (details in the attached CSV under "Monitoring & Analytics" row).

> 3) Do you ever use customer prompts or derived data for model training or improvement?
- No. Redwood does not use customer prompts or request/response pairs to further train shared models. We have an explicit policy against training on customer data unless there is an opt-in program and a separate commercial agreement.

> 4) Are BAAs available for HIPAA-covered workflows? If so, please share the template or process.
- Yes — we do offer a BAA for covered customers. I’ve attached our standard HIPAA/BAA template (redwood_hipaa_baa.pdf) and our DPA (redwood_dpa_v3.pdf). For procurement we can execute via DocuSign or your procurement system.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf, redwood_hipaa_baa.pdf

Dev (copied) — can you add a short note about encryption, key management, and whether telemetry contains PII?

Best,

Marissa

Hi Emma — quick technical addendum from our side: 

- Subprocessors (high level):
  - Cloud providers: AWS (primary), GCP (secondary/region-specific).
  - Managed DB/Storage: AWS RDS / Cloud Storage equivalent (depends on deployment).
  - Monitoring/Telemetry: Managed vendor (no customer PII in telemetry; we sanitize logs and redact prompt/response where required).
  - CDN & edge caching for static assets.

- Data boundaries & retention:
  - Inference request data is ephemeral in the runtime KV cache (kept in memory and not persisted by default). Short-term logs for debugging may be retained up to 30 days before automatic pruning, unless customer DPA specifies otherwise.
  - All data at rest is encrypted using customer or service-managed KMS keys. We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) for Dedicated/Private deployments.

- Access controls:
  - Least-privilege internal access with RBAC and audited access logs.
  - Support for SSO + SCIM for customer admins.

Next steps:
1) If you upload your security questionnaire to the Drive link (or send via DocuSign), we’ll assign it to our security team and return a completed copy within 5 business days.
2) Happy to schedule a 45-min technical review next Wed/Thu morning PT — Marissa/Rachel can propose times.

Regards,
